ruling.explanation: Both of you: the disputed trip is TRP-00111, Woodlands to one-north on 3 Aug 2026. It ran 29.98 km — the GPS trace figure, which POL-RD-01 makes govern over the trip record's rounded 30.0 km — against a booked optimal of 24.0 km. That is an excess of 5.98 km, or 24.9%, which clears the POL-RD-01 establishment gate (over 0.8 km AND over 20%), so a deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (below 50% and below 8.0 km), so the repeat-pattern inquiry in POL-RD-06 is not triggered and no conduct referral arises. Rider, the deviation you detected is real; the reason it does not produce a refund is the closure. The driver's diversion is fully exonerated under POL-RD-03: LTA advisory ADV-20260803-014 (HIGH-severity CLOSURE of the PIE towards Tuas between Clementi Rd and Jalan Anak Bukit, active 07:10–09:30, geometry intersecting the route, window overlapping the whole trip) covers the expressway segment the booked optimal route uses; the trace shows the vehicle leaving the corridor at Bukit Panjang, before the closed stretch, and rejoining it, and the advisory is matched by that actual route. The exoneration cap is min(measured excess, 1.30 x (29.2 - 24.0) + 1.00) = min(5.98, 7.76) = 5.98 km, which covers the entire excess. Nothing therefore survives for POL-RD-02 to refund. Even run for transparency against the closure-adjusted optimal (29.98 km, duration 30.0 x 29.98/24.0 = 37.5 min): charged_total = SGD 37.74; recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 29.98 + 0.28 x 37.5) x 1.0 surge (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, the only artifact carrying it) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = SGD 37.585; refund = SGD 0.155, below the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, so NO_ACTION either way. There is no pass-through correction under POL-RD-09: tolls_erp is 0.00, erp_gantries is empty and optimal_route_erp_sgd is 0.00, so no gantry is charged and none is phantom. Rider, your recollection that you 'did not see any closure' cites no artifact and cannot outweigh a timestamped government advisory covering the disputed segment. Driver, no compensation is due to you on this record. The rider-instruction route under POL-RD-04 is unavailable: the chat holds only a delivery-time reply carrying a null waypoint_hint and naming no road, so the corroboration test could not be run, and it does not exonerate or obligate anyone. The present charge stands as it is.
